reviews.snippet: Cok guzel agirlandik, harika bir yer. Ancak odalari tadilat ve yenilenmesi lazim, baya yipranmis. Ama calisanlar, ve konak olarak cok guzel bir yer. Merkeze yuru mesafesinde.
Tadilat yapılıyor, muhteşem manzarası var, çok merkezi bir konumda.
Pretty worn out rooms and a little dirty. We were given a sub-par room that was much lower grade than the one we purchased. Management was not accommodating or willing to correct their mistakes.

My wife and I stayed at Asfiya Hotel in the first week of October and we found out that it had been taken over by a management contract just before the season began. The hotel is now starting to look tired and is needing a good revamp over the closing season in order to maintain its luxury standard. We were disappointed that the old sun beds had gone as they were the best in Kalkan. Breakfast was okay. We will be returning to Kalkan next year and I’m not so sure that we will stay there.

The hotel is in a fantastic location, great views and quiet, easy walk into town and a nice stroll back to work off your food!|The staff can’t do enough for you and keep the place nice and clean. Ahmet the new manager talks to all the guests to make sure you are happy and is happy to offer advice on how to negotiate Kalkan.|Breakfast is always fresh with plenty of choice and you can have eggs cooked anyway you like.|Give it a try, you won’t be disappointed.
Only had a look around i would like to stay soon
